States: Texas

outages

Do some analysis for your state

  • What is the most common cause of power outages?
  • What cause leads to the longest power outages?

Common cause of outages

outages |> 
1  group_by (event_category) |>
2  summarize(total_events = n()) |>
3  arrange(total_events |> desc())
1
Exclusively looking at event_category.
2
Counting how many times each event_category has occurred.
3
Ordering from most to least occurrences.

Cause of longest outages

outages |> 
1  group_by (event_category) |>
2  summarize(avg_outage_length = mean(duration), total_occurences = n()) |>
3  arrange(avg_outage_length |> desc(), total_occurences)
1
Exclusively looking at event_category.
2
Finding average duration (mean), and including occurrences for comparison.
3
Ordering from longest to shortest average outage length.
